importantNotes: The catalogue stores real coordinate anchors, not measured 3D terrain, real drone permission, bathymetry, live views, or 360 panoramas.
Vehicle tags are game rules inferred from destination type; they are not real-world safety or access determinations.

Only photoId records reference bundled individually licensed images. Other records require verified runtime Commons images or show a no-photo state. sourceImages URLs are not approved for automatic display.

Taiwan histories retain original Traditional Chinese; the English short text is a location/category summary, not a translation of the history. UNESCO retains six source languages plus Traditional Chinese script conversion. Missing language must be visibly indicated.
The 18 dive practice variants are marked separately so the number of unique source attractions remains auditable.
